mapper.select: SELECT id, api_key_id AS apiKeyId, model_name AS modelName, model_avatar AS modelAvatar, model, platform, model_type AS modelType, temperature, max_tokens AS maxTokens, max_messages AS maxMessages, support_multimodal AS supportMultimodal, sort_order AS sortOrder, is_default AS isDefault, remark FROM bedrock_ai_model WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT m.id, m.api_key_id AS apiKeyId, m.model_name AS modelName, m.model, m.platform, m.model_type AS modelType, m.temperature, m.max_tokens AS maxTokens, m.max_messages AS maxMessages, m.support_multimodal AS supportMultimodal, m.status, m.remark, k.api_key AS apiKey, k.key_name AS apiKeyName, k.base_url AS baseUrl, k.api_path AS apiPath, k.status AS apiKeyStatus FROM bedrock_ai_model m LEFT JOIN bedrock_ai_api_key k ON m.api_key_id = k.id AND k.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.id = #{id} AND m.is_deleted = 0
